text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While searching for Trainer Kiryuin to 
invite her out—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
That's the timing. A light tap off your 
toes, focusing on using your right leg as 
your pivot.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ........Pivoting on the right foot.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
That's it. Make sure your movements don't 
become small or stiff.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Well? Do you think you can manage?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...I shall consider it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giving a brief nod, Happy Meek made her 
way over to the window.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To an onlooker, she seemed to be idly 
staring at the sky, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kiryuin watched over the scene 
patiently, without rushing anyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—thirty minutes passed just like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer <username>. Thanks for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: It's akin to image training.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Gazing at the sky while visualizing her 
movements…… It seems that's been her way 
of doing things for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
All I can do is watch over her, but I want 
to let her keep going until she is truly 
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It was right there in the Trainer's 
handbook: 'One must respect the 
Umamusume's heart.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, another thirty minutes after 
that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon her return, Happy Meek danced the 
routine through to absolute perfection.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Did that surprise you?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, . That happens to be one of that 
child's special talents.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
As long as she can picture it in her mind, 
there's no issue; she executes it with 
sheer perfection.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, you also need the physical 
capability to move in accordance with your 
mental image.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
And that can only be accomplished through 
unyielding, ceaseless effort.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Continuing to put in effort is by no means 
an easy feat.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I truly respect her from the bottom of my 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: You too, Trainer <username>?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...In that case, we are truly fortunate. 
To have someone by our side whom we can 
respect.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Still... there are others I respect, you 
know. Right nearby.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's a bit too embarrassing... so 
it's a secret for now.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer <username>. From now on, as peers, and as 
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Nice to meet you!
